XFX Radeon RX 9070 Series | Mercury Class
Leader of the Pack
The all new XFX AMD Radeon RX 9070 Series is the highest performance Radeon to date so if you are looking for the best of the best, look no further. Available in three performance tiers to choose from including the Mercury tier for enthusiast gamers, Quicksilver for mainstream gamers and Swift for casual gamers.
Pop off your fans. So you can pop off in games
Easy and Instant
The Magnetic Air fan hubs instantly lock into the GPU fan shroud frame with powerful magnets capable of supporting up to 1kg of weight. Once locked in Magnetic Air instantly sends both power and PWM data to the fans. Fans separation failures are now a thing of the past. Magnetic Air fans not only have improved longevity but provides stable performance for the entire life of the fan.
‍
*Magnetic Air fans are not available on all Mercury model cards.
ARGB with Motherboard Sync Capability
Customizable RGB
Select XFX Mercury Class features a full-length RGB element across the shroud to provide you with numerous personalization options to match your gaming rig or personal style.
‍
*RGB is not available on all Mercury model cards.
A Variety of Options
A Frosty Design
The XFX AMD Radeon RX 9000 Series is now available in both black and white editions across all models to match your gaming rig design needs whether it’s an all white or all black setup.
White LED Edition
Not into RGB and looking for a more clean modern look? Then look no further, our single white LED version is the perfect match for those looking for a simple modern minimalist look.
RDNA 4
Breakthrough Performance
ALL YOU NEED FOR ULTRA-FAST GAMING
‍
Speed, performance, and visuals work together for smooth frames and total immersion. The ultra-fast Radeon™ RX 9000 Series Graphics Cards are powered by unified AMD RDNA™ 4 compute units with enhanced raytracing capabilities for an ultra-immersive experience across all key gaming resolutions. Activate AMD HYPR-RX6 to instantly enable all supported performance boosting and latency reducing technologies across thousands of your favorite games. Enjoy high-quality, AI-powered upscaling with AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 41, delivering an immersive gaming experience now and for years to come.

Put your skills on full display with enhanced multimedia and streaming experiences with the AMD Radiance Display™ Engine.

UX with dependable drivers and day zero game support will ensure game optimizations are ready to go to deliver high frame rates, sharper visuals, and low latency for thousands of gaming experiences that await.

Pair it with AMD Ryzen™ 9000 series processors featuring PCI Express® Gen 5 support and the latest AMD Smart Access Memory™ technology3 to realize the full performance of your AM5 platform. Harness both Radeon and Ryzen AI-enabled technologies, and upgrade to next generation displays with DisplayPort™ 2.1 support, and up to 16GB of video memory to experience AAA games in all their visual glory, now and for years to come.
